{"assessments":[{"assessment_confidence":"medium","assessment_reason":"候选先有较长的连麦寒暄和重复语气词，随后明确比较美声、民族与流行唱法的发声通道，并指出需要针对性调整；核心观点可恢复，但内容混杂且部分术语受口语表达影响。","candidate_id":"candidate_b45014a64a6a9c53","content_risk_flags":["health_or_safety_claim","sponsor_or_advertising"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":["context_dependency"],"primary_claim":"美声、民族与流行唱法使用的发声通道不同，学习者需要依据自身唱法和声音位置进行调整。","risk_summary":"涉及可能影响嗓音使用的教学判断，并包含引导上课的推广表达。","scores":{"content_value":3,"editorial_utility":2,"evidence_fidelity":3,"hook_strength":1,"standalone_completeness":2},"topic_hypothesis":"不同唱法的发声通道差异","uncertainty_flags":["mixed_topics","claim_ambiguity"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"high","assessment_reason":"候选主要由连麦招呼、课程插队方式、直播间定位和对学员进步空间的评价组成，信息可以理解，但重复较多且主要服务于直播互动和课程推广。","candidate_id":"candidate_0f91c0dab3dbb1a2","content_risk_flags":["sponsor_or_advertising"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":[],"primary_claim":"直播间提供声乐教学连麦，并邀请观众通过指定互动方式参与或接受教学。","risk_summary":"内容包含明确的课程与直播互动推广。","scores":{"content_value":1,"editorial_utility":1,"evidence_fidelity":4,"hook_strength":1,"standalone_completeness":2},"topic_hypothesis":"声乐直播连麦与课程推广","uncertainty_flags":["mixed_topics"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"high","assessment_reason":"候选清楚说明一对一课程、课程录屏和因人而异的声音调整思路，也穿插用学员前后对比吸引新报名的商业表述；信息较完整，但推广色彩明显。","candidate_id":"candidate_26500385c10519ef","content_risk_flags":["health_or_safety_claim","sponsor_or_advertising"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":[],"primary_claim":"一对一课程会提供课程录屏供学员复盘，而声音位置的调整应根据每个人的具体问题决定。","risk_summary":"包含嗓音训练建议、学员案例营销和课程报名推广。","scores":{"content_value":3,"editorial_utility":3,"evidence_fidelity":4,"hook_strength":3,"standalone_completeness":3},"topic_hypothesis":"一对一声乐课的录屏复盘与个性化调整","uncertainty_flags":["mixed_topics"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"medium","assessment_reason":"候选提出流行与美声属于不同训练通道，并回应零基础学习需求，但中段被同行进入直播间的话题打断，末尾的问题缺少后续回答。","candidate_id":"candidate_1905cc42552496cb","content_risk_flags":["sponsor_or_advertising"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":["incomplete_claim"],"primary_claim":"流行唱法和美声训练被区分为不同通道，零基础学习者也可以从流行唱法开始学习。","risk_summary":"课程能力宣传清晰，但关于行业内部情况的话题在候选内没有展开。","scores":{"content_value":2,"editorial_utility":2,"evidence_fidelity":3,"hook_strength":2,"standalone_completeness":2},"topic_hypothesis":"流行与美声训练通道及零基础学习","uncertainty_flags":["mixed_topics"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"medium","assessment_reason":"候选表达了选择教师时应关注经验、音乐判断力和教学质量，而不能简单认为线下一定优于线上；不过论证依赖自我比较，并夹杂直播互动和贬低式对比。","candidate_id":"candidate_932087bda627a1c6","content_risk_flags":["reputation_or_defamation","sponsor_or_advertising"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":[],"primary_claim":"课程质量不由线上或线下形式单独决定，教师的经验、判断力和教学能力更重要。","risk_summary":"含自我课程推广，并以笼统方式贬低经验较少的教师群体。","scores":{"content_value":2,"editorial_utility":2,"evidence_fidelity":3,"hook_strength":2,"standalone_completeness":3},"topic_hypothesis":"线上线下声乐课与教师选择","uncertainty_flags":["mixed_topics"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"medium","assessment_reason":"候选明确描述声音过白可能带来疲劳，并把流行技巧与美声通道区分开来；后半段转入直播间同行互动，使教学观点的收束变弱。","candidate_id":"candidate_c09a0f37fab1e353","content_risk_flags":["health_or_safety_claim"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":[],"primary_claim":"声音过白可能导致演唱疲劳，流行唱法中的不同技巧应在相应发声通道内继续训练。","risk_summary":"涉及嗓音疲劳与发声训练判断，发布前宜由专业人员复核。","scores":{"content_value":3,"editorial_utility":2,"evidence_fidelity":3,"hook_strength":2,"standalone_completeness":2},"topic_hypothesis":"声音过白与流行唱法通道训练","uncertainty_flags":["mixed_topics","claim_ambiguity"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"high","assessment_reason":"候选以自身曾有高音紧、舌根紧和漏气等问题为例，说明其通过研究和付费学习总结教学方法；个人经历清楚，但从自身进步延伸到学员快速改善带有推广性质。","candidate_id":"candidate_159babdbda6acfe6","content_risk_flags":["health_or_safety_claim","sponsor_or_advertising"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":[],"primary_claim":"讲述者曾经历多种发声问题，并称自己通过持续研究和专业学习总结出改善这些问题的教学方法。","risk_summary":"包含嗓音改善主张和对自身教学效果的推广。","scores":{"content_value":3,"editorial_utility":3,"evidence_fidelity":4,"hook_strength":2,"standalone_completeness":3},"topic_hypothesis":"从个人发声问题到教学方法的形成","uncertainty_flags":[],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"high","assessment_reason":"候选围绕学员提出的喉咙和舌头状态问题，教师明确表示不能只看形状判断，必须先听实际声音；随后进入试唱准备，诊断尚未发生。","candidate_id":"candidate_9442184e2836ee47","content_risk_flags":["health_or_safety_claim"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":["incomplete_claim"],"primary_claim":"判断某种发声状态是否正确不能只依据口腔形状，需要先听到实际声音。","risk_summary":"涉及发声安全判断，且候选只完成了评估原则，未包含实际听辨结果。","scores":{"content_value":2,"editorial_utility":2,"evidence_fidelity":4,"hook_strength":2,"standalone_completeness":2},"topic_hypothesis":"发声姿态不能脱离实际声音判断","uncertainty_flags":["mixed_topics"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"high","assessment_reason":"候选是关于配音声线、外貌称赞和后续学习流行唱法的简短对话，最后清楚提出需要教师帮助调整发声通道；内容可理解但较薄。","candidate_id":"candidate_5c57e9b5dd359ae7","content_risk_flags":["sponsor_or_advertising"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":["context_dependency"],"primary_claim":"说话者正在练习流行唱法，并认为自己需要教师帮助纠正发声通道问题。","risk_summary":"包含对后续付费或课程学习的潜在推广语境。","scores":{"content_value":1,"editorial_utility":2,"evidence_fidelity":4,"hook_strength":1,"standalone_completeness":2},"topic_hypothesis":"配音学习者寻求流行唱法通道调整","uncertainty_flags":["missing_context","mixed_topics"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"medium","assessment_reason":"候选给出针对某位演唱者的具体诊断，认为声音缺少厚度和穿透力，并建议减少过高位置、增加下方支撑；核心方向明确，但多次使用指示性口语，无法从纯文本确认所指位置和声音表现。","candidate_id":"candidate_48324e904b930420","content_risk_flags":["health_or_safety_claim"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":["visual_verification_required"],"primary_claim":"该演唱者的声音位置偏高、下方支撑不足，调整声音厚度与支撑可能增强穿透力并减轻疲劳。","risk_summary":"嗓音诊断依赖未提供的声音或动作展示，且建议可能影响发声安全。","scores":{"content_value":3,"editorial_utility":2,"evidence_fidelity":2,"hook_strength":3,"standalone_completeness":3},"topic_hypothesis":"通过声音位置与支撑改善穿透力","uncertainty_flags":["visual_dependency","claim_ambiguity"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"medium","assessment_reason":"候选以讲述者的美声学习背景为依据，解释声音过白、唱后疲劳以及流行唱法中不同混声技巧的训练方向；开头承接前文，结尾也略显截断。","candidate_id":"candidate_4477e0c580eeaf0f","content_risk_flags":["health_or_safety_claim","sponsor_or_advertising"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":["context_dependency"],"primary_claim":"声音过白并容易唱后疲劳时，需要重新调整流行唱法的发声通道，再细分训练不同混声技巧。","risk_summary":"涉及嗓音疲劳和训练建议，同时以个人资历强化教学推广。","scores":{"content_value":3,"editorial_utility":2,"evidence_fidelity":3,"hook_strength":1,"standalone_completeness":2},"topic_hypothesis":"声音过白时的流行唱法通道调整","uncertainty_flags":["missing_context"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"high","assessment_reason":"候选先用学员反馈说明气息支撑的作用，随后纠正“腹式呼吸”的说法，强调胸腹式联合呼吸只是唱歌训练的一部分；观点具体，但夹有课程进步宣传和无关互动。","candidate_id":"candidate_2e74bd47f66c76ad","content_risk_flags":["health_or_safety_claim","sponsor_or_advertising"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":[],"primary_claim":"唱歌所需的呼吸配合更准确地说是胸腹式联合呼吸，而找到这种感觉只是把它用于演唱的起点。","risk_summary":"涉及呼吸和发声训练主张，并穿插对课程效果的推广。","scores":{"content_value":3,"editorial_utility":3,"evidence_fidelity":4,"hook_strength":2,"standalone_completeness":3},"topic_hypothesis":"胸腹式联合呼吸在唱歌中的作用","uncertainty_flags":["mixed_topics"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"medium","assessment_reason":"候选把不同地区口音与鼻音倾向联系起来，并据此诊断学员高音发散、建议调整咬字；核心对话可恢复，但部分语句明显受识别错误影响，且对地域群体和第三方的概括需要谨慎。","candidate_id":"candidate_995f11a38ef0e583","content_risk_flags":["health_or_safety_claim","reputation_or_defamation","copyright_or_third_party"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":["asr_uncertain"],"primary_claim":"讲述者认为该学员的地域口音带来较重鼻音，并建议调整咬字和声音集中度来改善高音发散。","risk_summary":"部分文字识别不清；内容涉及嗓音训练，并对地域群体及可识别第三方作概括性评价。","scores":{"content_value":2,"editorial_utility":2,"evidence_fidelity":2,"hook_strength":2,"standalone_completeness":3},"topic_hypothesis":"地域口音、鼻音与高音集中度","uncertainty_flags":["asr_ambiguity","claim_ambiguity"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"high","assessment_reason":"候选明确宣传课程进步与退费承诺，并把效果归因于教师经验和方法；主张容易理解且结构集中，但缺少支持其普遍性和退费条件的细节。","candidate_id":"candidate_4f46d35f2e2667ca","content_risk_flags":["legal_or_financial_claim","sponsor_or_advertising"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":[],"primary_claim":"讲述者声称其课程重视教师经验和教学方法，并承诺一定课次后没有进步可以退费。","risk_summary":"包含课程效果宣传及需要核实具体条件的退费承诺。","scores":{"content_value":2,"editorial_utility":3,"evidence_fidelity":4,"hook_strength":3,"standalone_completeness":3},"topic_hypothesis":"声乐课程效果与退费承诺","uncertainty_flags":["claim_ambiguity"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"high","assessment_reason":"候选比较线上与线下学习成本，给出线上无进步退费的承诺，并断言录播课对绝大多数人效果很低；观点完整、进入直接，但概率说法和商业承诺缺少候选内证据。","candidate_id":"candidate_b6ce4961df030128","content_risk_flags":["legal_or_financial_claim","sponsor_or_advertising"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":[],"primary_claim":"讲述者认为线上课程成本更低且可提供退费保障，并声称录播课对绝大多数学习者的效果有限。","risk_summary":"包含价格比较、退费承诺和缺少依据的课程效果概率宣传。","scores":{"content_value":2,"editorial_utility":3,"evidence_fidelity":3,"hook_strength":3,"standalone_completeness":3},"topic_hypothesis":"线上声乐课成本、退费与录播课效果","uncertainty_flags":["claim_ambiguity"],"unusable_reason":"none"}]}
